title: Smaller than what it looks like
text: Smaller than what it looks like. I purchased this and a crib for my daughter's first baby.  She and her husband had some difficulty putting it together.  She said her biggest disapointment was that the drawer size is much smaller than what it looks like in the picture.

product_metadata.title: Delta Children Bentley Six Drawer Dresser, Greenguard Gold Certified, Black Cherry Espresso
features: Strong and sturdy wood construction, 6 spacious drawers
Smooth metal drawer glide system with safety stops, which prevent drawers from pulling out, easy cleaning surface
Made of solid wood and wood composites, meets ASTM standards
Tested for lead and other toxic elements to meet or exceed government and ASTM safety standards, easy assembly
Assembled dimensions: 49 inches width x 19 inches depth x 33.50 inches height
description: Simple yet versatile, the Bentley 6 Drawer Dresser from Delta Children is a charming storage solution for growing kids. Designed to outlast trends and changing tastes, it boasts six spacious drawers, smooth metal glides with safety stops to prevent drawers from falling out, plus clean, crisp lines that will never fall out of favor.
